we have confirmed the disease-causing effect of the PKHD1 sequence variation c.51A> G by in vitro functional studies and we have demonstrated that the presence of two PKHD1 truncating mutations in a patient with ARPKD does not preclude survival into childhood.

(1) the c.51A > G sequence variation in exon 2 of PKHD1 is a pathogenic mutation, as it leads to the generation of a premature termination codon, (2) this mutation is associated with a severe form of ARPKD, and (3) the presence of at most one truncating mutation is sufficient to cause a severe ARPKD phenotype.
